BANK_RECEIVED: You received ${0} on your bank account
BANK_ERR_FAR: You are not at a bank
BANK_ERR_DENIED: You do not run this account
BANK_ERR_ATM: ATMs only pay out and transfer
BANK_ERR_ATM_LIMIT: That is more than an ATM moves at once
BANK_ERR_ATM_DAILY: That goes over your daily ATM limit; a bank branch has no limit
BANK_ERR_TARGET: Nobody with that id is in the city
PAYCHECK_PAID: ${0} of your paycheck was paid out
PAYCHECK_ERR_FAR: You are not at a paycheck office
PAYCHECK_ERR_EMPTY: No paycheck is waiting for you
PAYCHECK_ERR_AMOUNT: Enter an amount up to what is waiting
PAYCHECK_ERR_ACCOUNT: Your paycheck could not be paid into your account
PAYCHECK_ERR_FAILED: The paycheck could not be paid out
ADMIN_TAB_BANKS_DESC: Branches where players deposit, withdraw and see their transactions.
ADMIN_C_BANK_DESC: Players open the bank at its counter.
ADMIN_H_COORDS: Stand at the counter and use your position.
ADMIN_TAB_OFFICES_DESC: NPCs where players collect the salary ai-core keeps in office mode.
ADMIN_C_OFFICE_DESC: Players collect their waiting salary here. Shown only while Paycheck offices is on in Rules and ai-core's paycheck mode is Office.
ADMIN_H_OFFICE_COORDS: Stand where players talk to the clerk and use your position.
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: ATMs, their limits, the transfer fee, paycheck places and police reports.
ADMIN_C_RULES_DESC: ATMs pay out and transfer; deposits and society accounts need a bank.
ADMIN_H_ATM_MODELS: World props that work as ATMs (needs ai-target).
ADMIN_H_ATM_LIMIT: Most one ATM withdrawal or transfer moves. Bank branches have no limit.
ADMIN_H_ATM_DAILY: Most one character withdraws and transfers through ATMs in 24 hours. Counted in memory: a restart of ai-banking starts every count again.
ADMIN_H_FEE: Percent added to transfers to other players (0 = free).
ADMIN_C_PAYCHECK_DESC: Where players collect the salary ai-core keeps when its paycheck mode is Office (ai-core panel, Job and gang rules).
ADMIN_H_PAYCHECK_BRANCHES: The bank screen at a branch shows a Paycheck tab in ai-core's Office mode (in Account mode only while salary from Office mode is left).
ADMIN_H_PAYCHECK_OFFICES: Shows the NPCs, prompts and blips of the Paycheck offices tab. They appear only while ai-core's paycheck mode is Office.
ADMIN_C_POLICE_DESC: What ai-police hears about bank visits.
ADMIN_H_SIGHTINGS: Each opened bank or ATM screen is reported to ai-police, which can alert officers when the player is wanted. Does nothing while ai-police is not running.
